Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.content_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.html);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.title);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.description);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.canonical_url);
    println!("{:?}", result.links.len());
    println!("{:?}", result.links[0].link_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.images.len());
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.og_title);
}
```
